stages.name: fixtures
stages.claim: Recorded verdicts are at least 10 days from expiry and match the published attestation report.
stages.evidence: 4 of 4 recorded verdict sets at least 10 days from expiry; published attestation report sha256 matches tee/fixtures/verdicts.json; live registry.tnlab-368aa2.testnet set tee/fixtures/verdicts-368aa2.json: 19 records, every signature checked offline, signer 0x2665cce942fa427ef30d87f4b0bff67fb7645462, report sha256 matches
stages.label: includes the live registry.tnlab-368aa2.testnet set named in tee/status.json, checked offline

stages.name: tamper
stages.claim: The TEE flags an altered amount, a hidden prompt injection and a reused document, and passes 16 of 16 honest documents. Every reply signature is checked.
stages.evidence: T1 amount_mismatch, T2 injection_attempt, T3 duplicate_document; honest 16 of 16, every signature checked; Harbor 99.17 green then 51.59 red

stages.name: engine
stages.claim: Score engine: Harbor 99.17 green (public 99), Meridian 42.84 red (public 43); every worked-example field matches. TEE eval: 126 signed replies, 0 extra fields, 100% precision and recall on this synthetic set.
stages.evidence: Harbor 99.17 green (public 99), Meridian 42.84 red (public 43), every worked-example field matches; eval 86+40 signatures verified, 0 extra fields, 100% precision and recall on this set (limits in tee/eval/REPORT.md)

stages.name: v3 pin
stages.claim: The agent accepts only the engine hash pinned in receipts/v3-build.json. Any other engine is declined engine_hash.
stages.evidence: allowlist is exactly receipts/v3-build.json engine.sha256 098f5d86a94288d13fac1ca66b8aba9c20a2dc1b3585a64ef91d5bba5aa68788; another engine is declined engine_hash and bought 0, the pinned one bought 1 (fake chain); engine-pin tests 8 of 8 tests ok, 0 skipped; private pins 9917 / 4284 hold, public 99 / 43

stages.name: failed head
stages.claim: On a failed head, /report returns 409 run_failed, the entitlement is not used, and the agent buys nothing.
stages.evidence: DEMO-CREDIT failed head: /score and /report 409 {error: "run_failed"}, entitlement not redeemed; runAgent(execute) bought false, spent 0; 7 of 7 tests ok, 0 skipped
stages.label: local API on a fake chain with a disposable random test key, not an operator key

stages.name: paid report
stages.claim: /report without an entitlement returns 402; a one-use entitlement works once.
stages.evidence: /score free and unchanged after a purchase; a one-use entitlement returns 200 and the stored public receipt, a second use is refused; no entitlement is 402; 12 of 12 tests ok, 0 skipped
stages.label: local API on a fake chain

stages.name: dashboard data
stages.claim: Dashboard data: Harbor 99 green, Meridian 43 red, DEMO-CREDIT run_failed.
stages.evidence: wrote out/judge-dashboard.json (sha256 4405902e7205cb2e2403428cbdec3e6e76e1e94d842a9bb9c83b42e1d2209655): Harbor 99 green, Meridian 43 red, DEMO-CREDIT run_failed
stages.label: data only, no UI; the dashboard app is in web/

stages.name: mirror
stages.claim: The Base mirror contract accepts only the MPC signer and a rising sequence per token (local EVM, not deployed).
stages.evidence: Solidity compiles; local EVM enforces only-MPC and increasing per-token seq; every committed cross-check vector re-encodes; 10 of 10 tests ok, 0 skipped
stages.label: local replay on ganache (chain 84532), not deployed

stages.name: attest, local subset
stages.claim: Every loan fingerprint in tee/loans.json is the recorded OutLayer fingerprint, and the attestation report is the published one (offline part only).
stages.evidence: 19 of 19 tee/loans.json hashes match tee/fixtures/fingerprints.json (17 records, wasm 4a7c0e4ed5007ac6720b30906db4105bc302e35fb495003692225f630d1f07e3); attestation report sha256 matches; no RPC, OutLayer or Intel collateral used
stages.label: offline slice; the OutLayer, RPC and Intel collateral checks are npm run verify:fingerprints and verify:attestation, run live in CI

stages.name: stamp
stages.claim: A wasm swapped after stamping is detected as stale.
stages.evidence: a wasm swapped after stamping reads stale and CI throws; one-line, empty and source-only stamps read stale; 6 of 6 tests ok, 0 skipped
stages.label: fake wasm in a temp tree, nothing built; this does not show that a real target/ wasm is fresh
